parts.text:
关键！结构是 `.app-wrapper > .main-container > .right-container > app-main(.app-main)`。而 `.right-container` 是中间层。如果 `.right-container` 不是 `flex:1`/`display:flex` 让 `.app-main` 有确定高度，我的链条就断了。

而且注意 `portal-home-layout` class（`shouldHideLayoutChrome`）——B 端首页会加这个类。让我看 `.right-container` 和 `.portal-home-layout` 的样式。

**找到根因！** 关键在 `.right-container.portal-home-layout`（B 端首页 `shouldHideLayoutChrome` 时加上这个类）：

```css
.right-container.portal-home-layout {
  overflow: auto;          /* 改为滚动容器 */
  ::v-deep .app-main {
    height: auto;          /* ← 覆盖了原本 flex:1 的撑满 */
    min-height: 100%;      /* min-height:100% 相对 .right-container 的高度，但 .right-container 是 overflow:auto... */
  }
}
```

`.app-main` 被改成 `height:auto; min-height:100%`。`min-height:100%` 相对父 `.right-container` 的高度——但 `.right-container` 是 `flex:1` 有确定高度（视口高），所以 `100%` 应能解析。可 `overflow:auto` 的容器里 `min-height:100%` 的百分比解析… 实际上 app-main 变 `height:auto` 后，其内部 `.home-new` 的 `min-height:100%` 相对 app-main（auto）→ 失效！

**这就是为什么我复刻时假设 app-main 是 `flex:1`，但真实 B 端首页 app-main 是 `height:auto; min-height:100%`**。`.home-new` 的 `min-height:100%` 相对 auto 高度 → 0，所以 `home-new` 只有内容高度，`.home-layout-sidebar` 的 `flex:1` 也无处可撑（父 home-new 没确定高度）。所以我的 `flex:1 1 auto` 完全没起作用——**修复无效，正如用户说"没变化"**。

**正确修复**：让 `.home-new` 拿到确定高度。由于 `.app-main` 是 `min-height:100%`（高度=视口高，若内容少），应让 `.home-new` `min-height: 100%` 相对 app-main 生效。但 app-main 是 `overflow:auto` 且 `height:auto; min-height:100%`，其内容高度 = 视口高（因 min-height）。`.home-new` 需要 `min-height:100%` 相对它 → 但百分比 min-height 在 height:auto 的元素上不解析。

更稳的做法：既然 `.app-main` 在 portal-home-layout 下 `min-height:100%`+`overflow:auto`，让 `.home-new` 直接 `flex:1` 也可以——但 `.app-main` 是 `overflow:auto` **块**（不是 flex），`home-new` 是它的子块，`flex:1` 无效。

**最干净的修复**：在 `portal-home-layout` 下让 `.app-main` 成为 flex 纵向容器并把 `home-new` 撑满。或更简单——直接给 `.home-new` 设 `min-height:100%` 依赖 app-main 的 100%，而 app-main 的 `min-height:100%` 依赖 right-container 的确定高度。链条：right-container（flex:1，确定高）→ app-main（min-height:100% → 视口高，且 overflow auto）→ home-new（min-height:100% → 但 app-main height:auto，百分比 min-height 参考 auto = 内容高）。

真实可靠方案：**不要依赖 min-height:100% 百分比链**。让 `.app-main` 在 portal-home-layout 下用 `min-height: 100%`（已有），并把 `.home-new` 改为 `min-height: calc(100vh - ...)`？太脆。

最佳：在 `portal-home-layout` 下让 `.app-main` 变成 **flex 纵向容器**，`.home-new` 作为唯一子项 `flex:1`。这样 home-new 撑满 app-main（其 min-height:100%=视口高），home-new 内部 `.home-layout-sidebar` 的 `flex:1` 继续传导。让我验证这个推理并在复刻里按真实结构（含 right-container + app-main height:auto/min-height100% + portal-home-layout）重现"没变化"，再修。

先重建复刻，精确模拟真实链路。

Let me step back and think about what's ACTUALLY different. The user's screenshot: content ends at ~y=800, blank to 953. My repro (without hero/nav real components but with a 110px hero) fills to 933.

The difference: real hero banner is ~130px tall + nav menu, pushing layout start to ~180 instead of 130. But that alone wouldn't leave a 150px gap — flex:1 should still fill.

Wait — maybe the real issue is that in the real page **`home-new` is NOT the direct child of `.app-main`**. Let me check index-new template: `<div class="home-new">` contains hero, nav, layout. And index-new is the route component rendered in `<router-view>` inside `.app-main`. The transition wrapper `<transition>` renders `<router-view/>` directly → component root `.home-new` becomes direct child of `.app-main`. OK direct.

Hmm. Let me reconsider: maybe the fix IS working but the user has a **cached page**. The strongest evidence: user says "没变化" but their screenshot's AI-panel position is IDENTICAL to the pre-fix state. If they hard-refreshed and still nothing, it's either cache or wrong env.

The pragmatic path: **ask the user how they're accessing the page** (URL/localhost vs remote), and whether they hard-refreshed. But that's slow. Alternatively, make the fix **robust regardless of exact height chain** by giving `.home-new` an explicit `min-height` on the B-end path.

Actually — cleaner idea: rather than relying on `home-new`'s percentage height, set the fill directly on `.home-layout-sidebar` using `min-height: calc(100vh - offset)`? Brittle with hero/nav.

Let me look at whether `home-new` truly computes to full height in real page. I can't log in locally. But I CAN inspect: does `.home-new` have `min-height:100%` and does its parent `.app-main` have definite height? In `portal-home-layout`, `.app-main` = `height:auto; min-height:100%`. **`min-height:100%` on app-main resolves against parent `.right-container`** which has definite height (flex:1) → app-main min-height = 953. So app-main is ≥953. But `.home-new` `min-height:100%` against app-main: app-main's height is `auto` (its used height = content, but ≥953 due to min-height). Percentage min-height against a parent whose height is `auto` → **percentage resolves to `auto`/0** in most browsers when parent height is not definite in the height property. Chrome: min-height:% resolves against parent's height; if parent's height is auto, it's treated as 0 → min-height:0. So `.home-new` gets NO min-height → only content height!

That's the bug! In repro, my `.app-main` computed 953 because... in repro `.right-container.portal-home-layout .app-main` I set `height:auto; min-height:100%` too. Yet appMain measured 953. Because `.right-container` is `display:flex;flex-direction:column`, so `.app-main` is a flex child → `min-height:100%`... actually flex item with `min-height:100%` against flex container height. Hmm repro got 953.

The real difference may be that in the **real page the sidebar width/`content-fullscreen`** etc. This is too deep to fully trace blind.

**Decisive move**: make the fix not depend on the fragile `home-new` percentage chain. Instead, in `portal-home-layout` scope, make `.app-main` a flex column and `.home-new` flex:1. I'll add that to `layout/index.vue`'s `.right-container.portal-home-layout` block. This guarantees `.home-new` fills `.app-main` (which is ≥viewport via min-height:100%), independent of percentage min-height quirks.

Better: Let me just ask the user for the URL they're viewing — this is the true blocker and avoids wrong fixes.
